(259)zab gsang mkha' 'gro snying thig gi gsol 'debs bzhugs so/na mo gu ru/dngos med mtha' bral ka dag chos kyi sku/rang rig gsal mdangs lhun grub longs

tei:div.tei:p: zab gsang mkha' 'gro snying thig gi gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru/ dngos med mtha' bral ka dag chos kyi sku/ rang rig gsal mdangs lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs/ kun khyab thugs rje sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ dus gsum rang rig bla ma rnams la 'dud/ dmigs med chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang du/ kun bzang yab yum gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ ngo bo ka nas dag par byin gyis rlobs/ lhun grub chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang du/ longs sku zhi khro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ rig pa sku ru smin par byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rje phyogs ris bral ba'i pho brang du/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ snang sems 'jin pa stong par byin gyis rlobs/ dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang du/ dga' rab rdo rje nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ chos nyid don dang mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ dur khrod so so gling gi pho brang du/ shrī seng ha nyid la gsaul ba 'debs/ bde chen 'du 'bral med par byin (260)gyis rlobasa.a padma 'od kyi pho brang gzhal yas su/ o rgyan padma yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ 'bral med gzhan don 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ rig 'jin mkha' spyod dag pa'i pho brang du padma las 'brel rtsal la gsaul ba 'debs/ chos bka' ma lus tshang par byin gyis rlobs/ byar smad gro sa dpal gyi pho brang du/ sprul sku legs pa'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ rig 'jin gdung sob nus par byin gyis rlobs/ bsam yas mchims phu ngo mtshar pho brang du/ chos rje klong chen rab 'byams la gsol ba 'debasa.a bka' babs bstan pa'i rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ bsam gtan gling gi dben gnas pho brang du/ 'jam dbyangs khyab brdal lhun grub la gsol ba 'debs/ phyi nang 'khrugal lapa zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ phyogs med ri khrod dben gnas pho brang du/ sprul sku grags pa 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs/
rlabs chen don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/// /
